en: Sepia-toned photograph of a medieval stone ruin with multiple rounded and slightly pointed arches in succession, forming a corridor. The walls are rough-hewn masonry with some ivy or vegetation growing in the crevices. Upper parts show broken windows and crumbling stonework, suggesting the remains of a church or abbey. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
